messages.text:
I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Restored arrow-key navigation between cards, with movement stopping at board edges. Focus remains separate from card activation, and modified keys stay with the browser.

Added a browser regression check for navigation, modifier keys and the remembered tab stop. All 138 unit tests and the focused browser checks passed. The full browser suite passed 75 of 76 checks; the remaining face-art check timed out during concurrent testing and passed when rerun on its own.

The repository-wide formatting check still reports 13 pre-existing files outside this change. The edited files are formatted.
